C-CURRENT-VALIDATION-BOUNDARY-1-D8D7DF85.IntentSummary: T2 plan for the approved current-validation boundary. Three sequential tasks cut the three automatic archive readers while preserving every current guard. T-001 retires automatic archive-content enumeration in `src/artifact/grammar.ts`, keeping directory-name identity checks, active spec-to-plan coverage, and current structural validation. T-002 removes archived-plan assertion discovery from `src/lint/core.ts`, preserving active approved-baseline evaluation, the selected baseline/target/final rules, the shared `validateChangeArtifact`, and the current `--as applied` preview. T-003 removes archive-content inputs from the automatic query index in `src/query/core.ts` and repairs the selected-active context expectation. The unit layer proves the read boundary with a call-through `bun:test` `spyOn` over the real exported `readGraceXmlArtifact`; the CLI layer proves clean/mutate/restored behaviour on ordinary fixtures. The plan touches exactly the eight files named by the approved spec, keeps all four modules and verification anchors, and adds no README, examples, skill, status/scope, historical-navigation, reporting, or apply/close change. The five close-bound criteria keep their commands; full CI remains the selected `--assertions final --run-commands` gate and the whole-suite CloseEvidence criterion, not a per-task command.

T-001.Title: Retire automatic archive-content validation in project grammar

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red-first, before the runtime change: a new test selectable by `-t "current grammar treats archive content as opaque"` in `src/artifact/grammar.test.ts` fails, because an unrelated archived bundle with malformed `spec.xml` currently makes `validateNgraceProject` emit an `xml.parse` issue naming the archived path, and the call-through `bun:test` `spyOn` over the real exported `readGraceXmlArtifact` records calls under `.ngrace/changes/archive/`. Capture that red on an ordinary disposable project copy and record the command output.

In `src/artifact/grammar.ts`, the archive location of `validateChangeBundlesInDirectory` (invoked at `src/artifact/grammar.ts:1355`) no longer opens archived `spec.xml`, `plan.xml`, companion, or `design-context.xml` content. For an archive bundle it inspects directory names only: the `C-*` bundle-id identity, a loose `.xml` file directly under the archive directory (`change.unexpected-file`), and the required archive directory (`project.missing-change-directory`). Automatic spec-to-plan coverage is retained for active bundles and retired only for archives. Active-bundle section, version, and replacement validation is unchanged. No diagnostic is computed from archived content and then discarded.

Read-boundary proof: the test installs the call-through spy over the real exported `readGraceXmlArtifact`, drives the real `validateNgraceProject` over a complete ordinary project, asserts the recorded call set has no path under `.ngrace/changes/archive/` and has at least one current-artifact call as the positive control, then restores the spy. No fake parser, monkey-patched return, or fabricated result is used.

Behaviour, one changed archive input at a time, each case observed and then exactly restored before the next: (i) `spec.xml` malformed XML; (ii) `plan.xml` malformed XML; (iii) `spec.xml` with a differing `graceVersion`; (iv) `plan.xml` missing a required section; (v) an invalid `design-context.xml` companion. Each case yields 0 errors and exit 0 with no `xml.parse`, `change.spec-missing-section`, `change.plan-missing-section`, `change.spec-plan-id-mismatch`, `change.unregistered-section`, `change.scope-does-not-cover-spec`, or `change.applied-plan-missing` issue naming an archived path. Directory-name identity still refuses, and the active counterparts — the same malformed, version-invalid, and section-invalid mutations planted in an active bundle, plus an active spec-to-plan coverage mismatch — still refuse.

The existing archived superseded-replacement expectation at `src/artifact/grammar.test.ts:471-489` is re-homed: `change.superseded-replacement-not-found` is asserted for an active superseded bundle, not for an archived one, because the automatic archive path no longer reads archived replacement content. Timestamp-bearing lint JSON comparisons omit only the documented `generatedAt` field, and that normalization is disclosed. This is an intentionally invalid active-status control: assert both `change.invalid-active-status` and `change.superseded-replacement-not-found`, not a generic refusal.

T-002.Title: Remove archived-plan assertion discovery from current lint

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red-first, before the runtime change: a unit test selectable by `-t "current lint does not read archived plan assertions"` in `src/lint/core.test.ts`, and integration coverage in `src/grace-lint.test.ts`, fail because current lint reads the unrelated archived `plan.xml`. Capture the red with the command output.

In `src/lint/core.ts`, the archived-plan enumeration (`listPlanFiles(paths.changesArchiveDir)` at `src/lint/core.ts:727-729` and the archived loop at `src/lint/core.ts:544-547`) is removed, so current lint no longer discovers or extracts archived `BaselineAssertions` / `TargetAssertions`. Active approved-baseline evaluation under `--assertions current`, and the selected baseline, target, and final rules, are unchanged. `applyAsStatePreview` (`src/lint/core.ts:117`) and the shared `validateChangeArtifact` (`src/artifact/grammar.ts:678`) are untouched, including a current `--as applied` preview.

Read-boundary proof: a call-through `bun:test` `spyOn` over the real exported `readGraceXmlArtifact` drives the real `lintGraceProject` over a complete ordinary project and records zero calls under `.ngrace/changes/archive/` and at least one current-artifact call; the spy is restored.

Behaviour: with an opaque unrelated archive — including a `plan.xml` whose `BaselineAssertions` are malformed and a `MustExist` naming an unknown module, applied one case at a time and exactly restored — current lint reports 0 errors and exits 0 with no `assertion.*` issue naming an archived path. The paired control plants the identical malformed assertion in the selected approved active plan and still refuses. The existing archived-baseline test at `src/lint/core.test.ts:389-407` is rewritten so its premise matches the boundary while the positive archive-opacity assertion is added.

T-003.Title: Make the automatic query index and selected context current-only

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Red-first, before the runtime change: a test selectable by `-t "module query is unchanged by opaque archive content"` in `src/grace-query.test.ts`, and the selected-active slice test in `src/grace-context.test.ts`, fail because `collectOperationalValidationErrors` (`src/query/core.ts:93-99`) reads archived plans and `loadGraceArtifactIndex` (`src/query/core.ts:127-146`) then throws `invalid-project`. Capture the red with the command output. Run this red after T-001/T-002 using a distinct invalid archived plan/assertion fixture for both module and selected-active slice; the legacy malformed archived-spec expectation is a separate repair, not this red proof.

In `src/query/core.ts`, `collectOperationalValidationErrors` reads active plans only; the archive plan directory is removed from its assertion-issue input. The automatic index path no longer reads archive content. The `.ngrace` implementation-source exclusion (`collectCodeFiles` excludes `ARTIFACT_DIR`) and configured `ignoredDirs` and `codeExtensions` are preserved.

Read-boundary proof: a call-through `bun:test` `spyOn` over the real exported `readGraceXmlArtifact` drives the real `loadGraceArtifactIndex` over a complete ordinary project and records zero calls under `.ngrace/changes/archive/` and at least one current-artifact call; the spy is restored.

Behaviour, one archive change at a time (malformed spec XML, malformed plan XML, differing `graceVersion`, missing required section, invalid companion), each observed and exactly restored after: `ngrace module find M-QUERY --path <root>` exits 0 and returns exactly the same record as against the clean archive, and `ngrace context --task <T-*> --change <C-ACTIVE> --format json` returns exactly the same slice bytes. Context and module output compare byte-for-byte with no field filtering; after restoration both commands match the clean baseline exactly.

The forced selected-active expectation at `src/grace-context.test.ts:470-488` is repaired so the malformed unrelated-archive half asserts exit 0 and a byte-identical slice, while the malformed active-graph half (`:461-469`), the malformed selected-active spec half (`:490-510`), active assertion refusal, graph/verification corruption, and the `--as applied` current preview refusal are preserved. The source-exclusion decoy behaviour is preserved.

Assumptions.Assumption: The five close-bound criteria and their commands are preserved exactly from the approved spec. Full CI-equivalent verification belongs to execute/final (`--assertions final --run-commands`) and the `AC-CI-GREEN` whole-suite CloseEvidence criterion; it is not a per-task command and is not run during PLAN.

The `bun:test` `spyOn` over the real exported `readGraceXmlArtifact` observes the reads of `validateNgraceProject`, `lintGraceProject`, and `loadGraceArtifactIndex`; the authority verified this shape on a normal synthetic fixture. If it does not hold, the fix is a plan revision, not a runtime API change.
